thesis: Feldon’s Cane offered colorless graveyard recycling at almost no mana cost, giving early control decks insurance against decking and a way to reuse depleted libraries.

claims.summary: Exiling Feldon's Cane is part of the activation cost, so it is gone before the shuffle ability resolves. The ability shuffles only its controller's graveyard, not the opponent's, and does not put the Cane itself into the library. When an activated Cane has been tapped and exiled as costs, the controller shuffles the remaining graveyard into their library on resolution. If the ability is countered, the Cane remains exiled and the graveyard is not shuffled. It provides no extra draw by itself.
